title: game/data/residents.json: the people a run can invite to Copperleaf; each opens a service at a hub building (residents track RS-1; their levels are unlocks.json rows)

role.description: their profession, as the player reads it

home.description: where they live and work: a buildings.json key, a Copperleaf building's catalogue key (a prop's k), or house (a free cottage); check-data checks it

first.description: the free first resident: offered while nobody lives in Copperleaf (at most one row)

meet.description: where a run can meet them, and how likely they are among those left (0: not yet)

levels.description: their service's levels above 1: unlocks.json rows sold at their home, granting {resident, level} 2, 3, ... in order (RS-4)

about.description: who they are, in a line

service.description: RS-4: what their service does at each level, Lv 1 first (it comes with moving in); one more entry than levels; exactly one level is the power level

about.description: what this level adds, as the player reads it

power.description: the one power level (half and half: every other level adds options, not strength)

stock.description: wares their hub shop sells from this level on (Research and the like, into the hub bag)

reroll.description: rerolls of a run shop's stock a run

rumour.description: what a rumour shows at takeoff: a hidden node's type, or which place hides a side area

items.description: items put in the bag at each takeoff (items.json ids)

fx.description: effect rows on every run while they hold the level (logic/effects.js FX_KINDS, as a Perk's)
